policy.purpose: Record reviewed canonical naming, taxonomy, alias, and distinct-concept decisions discovered during q011/q012/q013 identity closure.

name_overrides.reason: Try Square is a スコヤ; 差し金/曲尺 is a different carpenter-square canonical handled by speed_square.
The existing record describes a bar clamp; generic クランプ/Clamp conflicts with the distinct scaffold-clamp canonical.
The q013 definition is a wheeled platform cart; distinguish it from the two-wheel hand-truck canonical.
The record is the manual soil tamper, not the powered rammer/compactor.
The record definition and aliases identify a paint/putty scraper; make the canonical identity explicit.
The canonical is the straightedge/screed tool, distinct from q011 Screeding process.

type_overrides.reason: record definition identifies a drywall joint reinforcement material, not a tool
form tie is a formwork spacing/tie component
formwork separator is a spacing component used with form ties and cones
rebar spacer block is a cover-maintaining component
tile spacer is a small spacing consumable/material rather than a tool
duplicate plural tile-spacer record represents the same spacing material
record definition identifies a flashing building component, not a tool
record definition identifies waterproof sealing tape material
full-body harness is fall-protection safety equipment
record definition identifies grout as a building material/consumable
record definition identifies a protective sheet/drop cloth material
access panel is an installed openable inspection component
diamond blade is a replaceable cutting consumable rather than a standalone tool
threaded rod is used as a fastening/hanging member and matches the q012 all-thread fastener concept
powered dust extraction unit is equipment rather than a hand tool
jobsite wet/dry vacuum is powered equipment
retired shop-vac duplicate represents powered jobsite vacuum equipment
retired air-compressor duplicate represents powered compressed-air equipment
A textile lifting sling is rigging gear rather than a general hand tool.
Lever hoist is lifting equipment and must match the q013 duplicate source taxonomy.
A reusable mixer paddle is an attachment/accessory rather than a consumable.
The existing mixing-paddle canonical is an attachment/accessory for a powered mixer.

alias_removals.reason: 野縁 and 胴縁 are related furring members but not canonical-equivalent Japanese terms
tie wire is the material used by the tying tool, not an alias of the tool
Screeding is the process; Screed is the tool/straightedge
firestop sealant is one product subtype within the broader firestop system/material family
generic wall/ceiling access panel should not alias the floor-specific inspection-hatch canonical
a planned construction joint is distinct from an unintended cold-joint defect
repair mortar is a specific mortar subtype, not an equivalent name for the broader repair-patch material family
generic wrench is broader than the q012 open-end spanner canonical; Japanese スパナ is retained on the specific entry
the maintained speed_square record actually represents 差し金/Carpenter's Square; Framing Square is a separate q012 canonical and generic Square is overbroad
Try Square/スコヤ is distinct from 曲尺・差し金
masonry chisel is distinct from the broader cold-chisel/taga-ne concept; Wood chisel was also an incorrect equivalent alias
A C-clamp is a different clamp form and must not be an alias of the bar-clamp canonical.
Lifting sling is the broader parent class; sling belt is the textile/webbing subtype.
Reserve Dolly for the platform-dolly canonical; hand truck is a two-wheel upright transport device.
Reserve 巻尺 here for the long reel tape canonical; pocket/retractable tape measure remains a separate entry.

resolved_distinct_pairs.reason: 野縁 is ceiling furring; 胴縁 is wall/backing furring. Related members, not the same canonical concept.
養生シート is overloaded: q011 is curing/drying-control context; protective_sheet is finish/floor surface protection.
curing sheet and drop cloth/protection sheet serve different site functions despite shared Japanese wording.
結束線 is consumable wire; rebar_tying_tool is the tool that twists/applies it.
Screeding is the leveling process; Screed is the tool/straightedge used for it.
firestop is the broader rated penetration treatment/material system; firestop sealant is one sealant subtype.
q011 is specifically an underfloor inspection hatch; access_panel covers wall/ceiling service access.
cold joint is an undesirable defect from delayed placement; construction joint is a planned/formed pour joint.
repair mortar is a mortar subtype; repair_patch is the broader repair-material family.
q012 is specifically an open-end wrench/spanner; wrench is the broader wrench family.
q012 大矩/Framing Square is the large framing-layout square; speed_square currently carries the 差し金/Carpenter's Square canonical.
Try Square/スコヤ is a different woodworking square from 差し金/Carpenter's Square.
Cold chisel/taga-ne and masonry chisel overlap in chipping use but are different tool concepts and material applications.
Japanese 幅木 can mean a scaffold toe board or an architectural baseboard/skirting; the installed functions are different.
dust extraction connected to cutting/grinding is distinct from a general jobsite wet/dry cleanup vacuum.
Scaffold clamp connects scaffold tubes; bar clamp holds workpieces for fabrication.
Lifting sling is the general rigging class; sling belt is the textile/webbing subtype.
Platform dolly is a flat wheeled platform; hand truck is an upright two-wheel transport device.
Long reel tape is for longer site dimensions; tape_measure is the pocket/retractable tape canonical.
